media.altText: Detail of a 1930 magazine photograph showing Herbert Stothart seated with sheet music.
media.description: The printed caption reads: "Herbert Stothart, right, goes over a new song with Ramon Novarro, who sings several numbers in 'Devil May Care.'" The caption reverses the two men. The figure on the right is identifiable as Ramon Novarro by comparison with his published portraits, so the composer is the man on the left, in shirtsleeves with the sheet music, and it is that figure which is reproduced here. The caption names only these two, which is what makes the identification safe.
media.publicCaption: Herbert Stothart, who scored Mutiny on the Bounty and A Night at the Opera in 1935 and San Francisco in 1936, going over a new song with Ramon Novarro for Devil May Care. Detail of a photograph printed in Picture Play in 1930, in a feature on the theme song at the coming of sound.

media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. The photograph was published in Picture Play Magazine in the first half of 1930, before 1 January 1931, so United States copyright has expired. No photographer is credited in the magazine. The image may remain protected in jurisdictions that do not apply the rule of the shorter term to United States works.
